Patronus AI/ Merch lab

Internal · Unlisted · 191 concepts

01 · Merch sprint, October 2026

Every concept, drawn from the brand.

Ink and bone, the cube's exact geometry, the domain drawings, the Earth as Art plates and the survey lines, on things people wear and keep. Clothing is shown as photo renders: the garment photograph is AI-generated and blank, and the design on it is our real artwork, placed and blended in; tap Vector for the drawing. Star what you love, mark maybes, reject the rest and leave a note. Your picks stay in this browser; Copy picks gives you a summary to paste back.

Nothing matches.

Vector mockups use only real assets: the cube (PRJ-007-M) and the "Patronus AI" lockup; the domain line drawings; the homepage hero's line and Sandur drawing; USGS Earth as Art paper plates and the 1903 Bright Angel survey (public domain, credit USGS); domain landscapes in warm black and white (public domain and CC0). Items tagged "AI render" also have a photographic render: the garment, fabric and light are AI-generated, the mark is the real SVG composited on top. Those renders live only on this page. No team photos.
